name: Honey Drip
description: The first clip sags like honey hanging from the top of the frame: its bottom gathers into one heavy amber drop that pulls the middle into a thinning glossy thread, the thread snaps, the drop falls out of the frame and the rest springs back up, revealing the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: snap
params.description: When the thread snaps, as a part of the transition

params.name: gloss
params.description: Strength of the glossy shading, amber depth and refraction
